page.overview:
Who is Boma?

Before Yangchen left the Western Air Temple, Boma made an oath to the Western elders to keep her safe. Boma looked after her until and after she became a fully-realized Avatar.

When Yangchen was summoned toward Tienhaishi a week after she mastered all four elements, Boma accompanied her there, despite Yangchen's protests that she would be fine on her own. He had refuted those claims, stating that he had promised the Air Nomad nuns that he would look after her until she was ready to be on her own and that it was never a good idea to break a promise to a nun. During the Avatar's audience with the king, Boma was present as well, taking care of Yangchen's two winged lemurs, Pik and Pak, whom he comforted after they were scared by the local fortunetellers.

Believing the prophecy that something bad was to befall the city from the sea, Boma accompanied Yangchen on her stakeout on a cliff overlooking the water. When General Old Iron appeared and knocked Yangchen down, he helped her up and urged her to stop the rampaging spirit while he evacuated all the citizens to a nearby clearing.

As Yangchen began to settle into her official, diplomatic responsibilities, he occupied a strange and undefined role in her retinue. He did not look the part of a dignitary with his weathered face and plain way of speaking, and nobles sometimes rankled at his presence, while Boma had no problem rankling back. Some time after the evacuation of Tienhaishi, Boma and Yangchen went to Bin-Er together for the Avatar's first official visit to one of the shang cities. When Yangchen stayed at the Blue Manse at the edge of the shang district, Boma handled Yangchen's security team, and who was being hired and fired.
